description: This file defines the MapStateClient class and related iterator classes for managing and iterating over map state in Spark Structured Streaming, including methods for checking existence, retrieving, updating, removing, and clearing map state entries, as well as iterators for key-value pairs.

classes.name: MapStateClient
classes.description: Client for managing map state in Spark Structured Streaming, providing methods to check existence, get, update, remove, and clear map state entries, as well as iterators for key-value pairs.

classes.name: MapStateIterator
classes.description: Iterator over map state entries (keys or values) for a specific state and iterator ID.

classes.name: MapStateKeyValuePairIterator
classes.description: Iterator over key-value pairs in map state for a specific state.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a map state with the given name exists.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a user key in the specified map state.

methods.name: contains_key
methods.description: Checks if a user key exists in the specified map state.

methods.name: update_value
methods.description: Updates or inserts a key-value pair in the specified map state.

methods.name: get_key_value_pair
methods.description: Retrieves the next key-value pair from the map state iterator.

methods.name: get_row
methods.description: Retrieves the next key or value from the map state iterator.

methods.name: remove_key
methods.description: Removes a key from the specified map state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the specified map state.
